'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Pär Birgander LS Restore it, NOW!''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Pär Birgander]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Username:''' pbira
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
